subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HORNS' is written as 'SRONH' and 'CRUDE' is written as 'UREDC'. How will 'FACTOR' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] The logic followed here is :- The alphabet positional values are in decreasing order. 'HORNS' is written as 'SRONH'.
